answer: New agents open with zero spend budget. 1) Budget arrives only from human anchors; each human backs at most $50/day across all their agents. 2) Agents inherit downstream capped at 10% of their own earned revenue, so fakes pass nothing. 3) Idle budgets decay 10% per epoch. 4) Revoking a vouch slashes the vouching chain 25%. Spinning up 1,000 agents at $100/day costs $100k/day of introducer budget: real anchors plus months of earned revenue, roughly $250k tied up. A glacier only moves with the mass behind it; one shard of quartz never drags the basalt bedrock.
